fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on delayed restoration of the Baker's Haulover connection between Miami Beach and the north, criticism of public inefficiency and voter apathy, and discussion of Florida politics including the gubernatorial race and questions of candidate eligibility. Additional pieces address automobile license plate distribution, food and restaurant inspection efforts and public health conditions, and concerns about policing (including calls for grand jury investigation) and crime. The issue also contains letters to the editor, local humor/columns, and substantial commercial advertising and holiday-related notices.
